about.title: About Ovulation Calculator - Fertility Tracking Tool
about.description: The Ovulation Calculator predicts your most fertile days based on your menstrual cycle length and last period date. Understanding your ovulation window is crucial for family planning, whether trying to conceive or avoid pregnancy. Ovulation typically occurs 12-16 days before your next period. This calculator helps identify your fertile window, peak fertility days, and provides insights for reproductive health planning.

howTo.title: How to Use the Ovulation Calculator

steps.title: Enter Last Period Date
steps.description: Input the first day of your last menstrual period using the date picker.

steps.title: Set Cycle Length

steps.title: Plan Accordingly

faq.a: Predictions are estimates based on average cycles and can be accurate within 1-2 days for regular cycles. Actual ovulation timing can vary due to stress, illness, or hormonal changes. Use additional methods like basal body temperature tracking for more precision.

faq.q: What is the fertile window and why is it 6 days?
faq.a: The fertile window is the 6-day period when pregnancy is possible - 5 days before ovulation plus ovulation day. Sperm can survive up to 5 days in the female reproductive tract, while the egg is viable for about 24 hours after ovulation.

faq.q: Can I use this calculator for birth control?
faq.a: This calculator is for educational and awareness purposes only and should not be relied upon as a sole method of contraception. The fertility awareness method requires additional tracking. Consult healthcare providers for reliable birth control options.

faq.q: What if my cycles are irregular?
faq.a: Irregular cycles make prediction less accurate since ovulation timing varies significantly. Track multiple cycles, note any patterns, and consider consulting a healthcare provider for personalized guidance on fertility timing and potential underlying causes.
